offers.requirements:
What we expect of you

  • Solid experience as a front-end developer at mid-level or senior level, ideally from an agency, start-up or consultancy

  • Strong skills in TypeScript and Next.js/React

  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted and agentic development (tools like Claude Code or similar) and real curiosity about pushing this frontier

  • A passion for design and interaction – functional, relevant and carefully crafted

  • Good at understanding real-world client problems 

  • Take ownership: of your code, your projects and products

  • You speak and write fluent Danish and are comfortable working in English

It’s a plus if you have experience with animation and interaction (e.g. GSAP or WebGL), or building AI-native features.

Please expect no less from us

The most important thing that we offer is an inspiring and ambitious work environment, with an emphasis on learning and developing, both personally and as a team. We have an informal organization with minimal hierarchy, where there is plenty of room for being ambitious within your own area of expertise, as well as taking part in shaping our team, culture, and product offering.

But, of course, we can also tempt you with:

  • Yearly one-week team trip with both social and professional focus (paid)

  • Fresh catered lunch of mostly organic produce and with vegetarian options

  • Coffee, tea, soft drinks, snacks, etc. – and wine, beer and drinks on Fridays

  • Beautiful office space with emphasis on noise reduction, centrally located in Vesterbro

  • Paid equipment of high quality – you choose what you prefer

  • In-office massage service

  • Inspiration trips to events, meet-ups and conferences

  • Company-paid pension and health insurance

  • Competitive salary based on qualifications and performance

  • Career progress based on merits rather than seniority

  • Opportunity to work-exchange with our offices in Montreal, London and Toronto

And if you think something is missing, just let us know. We can probably work together to add it. After all, we are trying to create the best possible place to work!

Practical information

  • Position: Full-time, 40 hours per week

  • Location: Signifly, Vesterbrogade 46, 1st floor, Copenhagen V

  • Language: Danish

  • Tech stack: TypeScript, Next.js, React, and Tailwind

Please submit your CV or online profile (LinkedIn or GitHub) – and feel free to include links to projects you’re proud of. Then we will be in touch!
offers.description:
We are looking for a creative Developer, inspired by innovation and creative thinking.

Signifly is an award-winning agency, behind some of the Danes’ favourite apps and digital experiences. 

We are looking for a Creative Developer with experience in shipping with AI and strong front-end skills to join our Creative Tech team in Copenhagen. You will be an essential part of developing new digital concepts together with our clients and colleagues, both here in Vesterbro and across our offices in London, Montreal and Toronto.

Things that matter: TypeScript, Next.js, and React, an eye for detail, love good design and building products that matter to real people. 

About Signifly

Signifly is one of the fastest growing innovation agencies in Denmark. Our team has won several awards for our innovative approach to digital products and user experiences. We are an ambitious team that is constantly pushing the limits of our work and our own capabilities.

We collaborate with a broad range of clients from all industries to create new and innovative digital products and business models. We are a team of developers, designers, film makers and digital strategists, and we believe that creativity, entrepreneurship and a diverse mix of top-notch skills can drive the innovation and change that will help shape a better tomorrow.

Agentic engineering – with craft at the core

We’re operating in a time of agentic engineering. AI agents are changing how software gets built, and we embrace that: we use agentic tools to ship faster and build AI-powered features into client products.

At the same time, we know that reaching the quality we aim for means sticking to the fundamentals of good software development. Agents amplify good engineering, they don’t replace it. We’re looking for someone with strong fundamentals in architecture, code quality and judgment, who can put these new tools to work without compromising on craft.

Key tasks

  • Build creative digital products and services, with a heavy focus on developing smooth, best-in-class front-end, interactions and user experience.

  • Turn design into performant, accessible and maintainable solutions in TypeScript and Next.js

  • Use agentic tools in your day-to-day development and help build AI-powered features into our clients’ products

  • Stay up to date with new trends and technologies and share your knowledge, so the team can deliver exciting and innovative solutions

  • Support with tech knowledge and skills across Signifly’s different teams
offers.title: Creative Developer

offers.description:
Are you a strategist who can go from a client's business problem to a brand idea to a creative brief without missing a beat? Read on.

Our Montréal strategy team is looking for a Senior Strategist with strong roots in creative work and the range to move between brand, communication and business challenges. One week you're writing a campaign brief. The next you're building a brand platform or helping a client rethink how they go to market.

You're both a leader and a doer. We care more about your thinking and your work than your current title.

What you'll do

  • Strategy work across a mix of projects: creative campaigns, brand development, digital experiences and business or go-to-market challenges.

  • Find the insight that unlocks the work, through research, client immersion, cultural observation and a good dose of curiosity.

  • Write creative briefs that inspire, and stay close to the creative team through concepting and production to keep the idea sharp and on strategy.

  • Build brand platforms: positioning, purpose, personality, messaging and storytelling.

  • Help clients connect brand ambition to business goals, whether that means a launch plan, a new offering or a customer experience strategy.

  • Present to clients and win them over. Tell the story behind the work in a way that makes the room lean in.

  • Look past the initial scope to spot new growth and innovation opportunities for every client.

What you bring

  • 6+ years in strategy (creative, brand or communications) at an agency, with work you can walk us through where your thinking visibly shaped the outcome.

  • Real fluency in the creative process. You know how to work with creative directors, designers, copywriters and filmmakers, and you earn their trust.

  • Solid brand strategy experience, from positioning and brand platforms to identity projects.

  • Enough business sense to hold your own with a CMO or CEO, and an understanding of how brand and creative decisions drive commercial results.

  • A proper pencil-chewer's pen. You write clearly and persuasively, and you can say a lot in very few words.

  • The ability to go from big-picture brand dreams to concrete business objectives, and back, in the same meeting.

  • Comfort structuring a strategy on your own, from blank page to final deck.

  • The ability to read a room, understand what clients really need, and help sell the work.

  • Energy in an environment that changes constantly. No two projects look the same here.

  • Fluent written and spoken English and French.

Please expect no less from us

The most important thing we offer is an inspiring and ambitious work environment, with an emphasis on learning and developing, both personally and as a team.

We believe the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. We create a work environment with plenty of room for being ambitious within your own area of expertise, or to take part in shaping our team, culture, and product offerings.

But, of course, we can also tempt you with:

  • Group insurance plan (partially paid), including extended health, travel, dental etc., for you and your family

  • Group Pension Plan (WealthSimple)

    Catered (GREAT) lunch

  • Yearly one-week team trip with both social and professional focuses (paid)

  • Coffee, tea, soft drinks, and snacks, anytime

  • Hybrid work and flexible working hours

  • Beautiful office space, centrally located in Old Montréal

  • Voluntary sports activities

  • Inspiration-trips to events, meet-ups, and conferences

  • Career progress based on merits rather than seniority

And if you think something is missing, just let us know. After all, we are trying to create the best possible place to work!

About Signifly

At Signifly, we work in collaboration with a broad range of clients from all industries, to create new and innovative brands, digital products and business models.

We are a team of strategists, designers, filmmakers, developers, and growth marketers who believe that creativity, entrepreneurship, passion and a diverse mix of top-notch skills can drive the kind of change to shape a better and more sustainable tomorrow.

Check out our work at Signifly.com

Ready to do the best work of your career? Join our digital journey!
